# Skunkworks Academy

Skunkworks Academy provides instructor-led, self-paced and portal-based learning across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, software development, productivity, labs and career pathways.

## Main domain

- Academy home and ecosystem navigation: https://skunkworksacademy.com/
- Self-paced catalogue: https://skunkworksacademy.com/self-paced/
- Microsoft training catalogue: https://skunkworksacademy.com/microsoft/index.html

## Claude self-paced courses

- CLD-UF-101 — Claude User Fundamentals: https://skunkworksacademy.com/self-paced/claude/cld-uf-101/
- CLD-DEV-201 — Claude for Developers: https://skunkworksacademy.com/self-paced/claude/cld-dev-201/

## Academy subdomains

- Learner portal: https://portal.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Jobs and talent pathways: https://jobs.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Practical labs: https://labs.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Blog and updates: https://blog.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Documentation: https://docs.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Prompt library and templates: https://prompt.skunkworksacademy.com/
- Publishing workflow: https://publish.skunkworksacademy.com/
